name: shell-fixture-aliases
goal: Resolve component fixture aliases correctly through both public and canonical build config entries

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Component gallery builds fail because relocated shell config retains URL aliases relative to its previous folder. Every alias must identify its actual source owner.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing cold config tests omit shell Vite aliases. Extend that standard matrix to evaluate both public and canonical entries in fresh Bun runtimes and assert all five real targets.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red b8a7675b at d2077b68d fails the exact source owner assertion for both cold config entrypoints.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 773af8472 fixes the five URL aliases relative to the canonical folder while preserving the public entry.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed green f54fbbe8 passes both unchanged cold alias cases at 773af8472; all seven normal config cases pass too.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
